title: 第二百一十六章 没那么痒了第二百一十五章 你是最了解我身体的人
content_zh:
第二百一十六章没那么痒了！
那人抬起头看了她一眼，目光里没有感激，只有警惕道：“你们城里来的医生，之前给我们开的药吃了也没用，现在又让我们吃药，到底有没有作用呀？”
“试过了，而且是我本人亲自试的，保证没问题。”孙菲菲端详着对方的脸色，理解道：“大哥，你放心吧，我们只会努力想办法救你们，不会害你们的。”
那人看着她，又看了看她手里那碗药液，嘴唇动了动，最终还是没有接，“那也不行，我不想当实验品。”
人群里一阵骚动。
有人往后缩了缩，有人的目光躲闪了一下，有人低声对旁边的人说道：“万一喝了更严重怎么办？”
一个老者从人群里站了出来，干瘦的手里拄着一根磨得光滑的竹竿，好像对城里的医生有意见。
“你们这些城里来的医生，前前后后来了好几拨，开了那么多药，有哪个药是真的管用了？都是拿我们当试验品，治不好了就说我们命不好，拍拍屁股就走了。”
孙菲菲的手悬在半空中，端着那碗药液，进退两难。
王大壮从她身后走过来，蹲在那个男人面前，把碗接过去耐心到：“大哥，我理解你的顾虑。但这碗药，真的是能救命的。这味主药叫赤阳草，是古方里专门治瘟疫的。你们村后山南面那片悬崖上，长着这种草药，我亲自去采的。你要是不放心，我亲自喝给你看！”
说着，王大壮便将这碗药一饮而尽。
那个男人抬起头看了他一眼，目光里的警惕没有完全消退，却也没有刚才那么强烈了。
王大壮把碗重新端到他面前道：“你看，我喝了都没事儿，你们要是不想喝也不勉强，毕竟受苦的是你们，而不是我们！”
这句话有点伤人，可王大壮可跟其他医生不一样，这群农村人有大部分都没文化，有时候会蹬鼻子上脸。
话音落下后，男人沉默了一会儿，慢慢伸出手，接过了那碗药液，仰头几口喝完了。
之后，他把空碗放在地上，咳嗽了两声，过了片刻，眼睛微微睁大了一些，低头看了看自己的手背：“好像……没那么痒了。”
此话一出，院子里安静了。
“这是什么药，效果这么快就见效？”
“真的假的，虎子，你不是托吧？”
“医生，这是你们研制的特效药吗，喝了要不要给钱呀？”

王大壮看着众人笑呵呵道：“不要钱，免费给大家治病的。”
孙菲菲也没想到这赤阳草的功效这么厉害，当即对村民们解释道：“乡亲们，这药不要钱，大家可以放心喝！”
于是乎，不少村民都开始蠢蠢欲动。
毕竟瘟疫折腾得他们生不如死，所以一个个开始排队。
content_en:
Chapter 216: Not so itchy anymore!
The man raised his head and glanced at her. There was no gratitude in his eyes. He only said warily: "The doctors from your city gave us medicines that were useless before we took them. Now they are asking us to take medicines. Does it have any effect?"
"I have tried it, and I have tried it myself. I guarantee there will be no problem." Sun Feifei looked at the other party's face and understood: "Brother, don't worry, we will only try our best to find a way to save you, and we will not harm you."
The man looked at her, then at the bowl of liquid medicine in her hand, his lips moved, but in the end he didn't take it, "That's not okay, I don't want to be a test subject."
There was a commotion in the crowd.
Some people shrank back, some people's eyes averted, and some people whispered to the people next to them: "What if it gets worse after drinking?"
An old man stood out from the crowd, holding a smooth bamboo pole in his thin hands, as if he had some objections to the doctors in the city.
"You doctors from the city have come and gone several times and prescribed so many medicines. Which medicine is really effective? They all use us as guinea pigs. If they can't be cured, they say that our lives are bad, pat our butts and leave."
Sun Feifei's hand was hanging in the air, holding the bowl of medicinal liquid, and she was in a dilemma.
Wang Dazhuang came from behind her, squatted in front of the man, took the bowl and patiently said: "Brother, I understand your concerns. But this bowl of medicine can really save lives. The main medicine is called red sun grass, which is specially used to treat plague in ancient prescriptions. This herb grows on the cliff south of the mountain behind your village. I picked it myself. If you are worried, I will drink it for you personally!"
With that said, Wang Dazhuang drank the bowl of medicine in one gulp.
The man raised his head and glanced at him. The vigilance in his eyes had not completely faded, but it was not as strong as before.
Wang Dazhuang brought the bowl back to him and said, "Look, it's okay for me to drink it. If you don't want to drink it, don't force it. After all, it's you who suffer, not us!"
This sentence is a bit hurtful, but Wang Dazhuang is different from other doctors. Most of these rural people are uneducated, and sometimes they get into trouble.
After the words fell, the man was silent for a while, then slowly stretched out his hand, took the bowl of medicine, raised his head and drank it in a few sips.
After that, he put the empty bowl on the ground and coughed twice. After a while, his eyes opened slightly, and he looked down at the back of his hand: "It seems... it's not that itchy anymore."
As soon as these words came out, the courtyard became quiet.
"What kind of medicine is this that works so quickly?"
"Really or not, Huzi, aren't you asking for help?"
"Doctor, is this a special medicine you developed? Do you want to pay for it after drinking it?"
Wang Dazhuang looked at everyone and said with a smile: "No money, we will treat everyone for free."
Sun Feifei also didn't expect that the red sun grass was so effective, so she immediately explained to the villagers: "Folks, this medicine is free, you can drink it with confidence!"
As a result, many villagers began to get ready to take action.
After all, the plague had made their lives worse than death, so they started lining up one by one.
